description: Fetch artifact metadata (and SHA-256 on hosted MCP) for a succeeded job output. Stdio may also write bytes when output_path is set. Requires bearer key. No charge on hosted. Returns: Artifact downloadUrl, mediaType, sha256 (hosted does not write local files). Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED, NOT_FOUND, DIRECTORY_CAPABILITY_DENIED when policy blocks.

artifact_id.description: Required artifact id from job artifacts or run result.
artifact_id.title: Artifact Id

job_id.description: Required owning job id (scopes the artifact download URL).
job_id.title: Job Id

name: hydracept_download_artifact
title: Read artifact metadata
